translation: The ankle bone (踝骨) is the prominent bone that protrudes on the two sides, below the hang bone (胻骨) and above the dorsum of the foot (足跗). The one on the inside is called the inner ankle (內踝), commonly called the he bone (合骨); the one on the outside is the outer ankle (外踝), commonly called the he bone (核骨). Whether one is injured by falling from a galloping horse, or by a misstep while walking, then the heel bone turns forward and the tip of the foot turns backward, with the sinews turned over and the flesh swollen, and unceasing pain.
